notes: Cabinet dimensions are quoted by the QD GmbH description under 'General system details for MPMS 3 liquid helium and EverCool dewar' (same ~84x105x200 cm / 400 kg figure as the EverCool page of brochure 1500-103), so they apply to the standard LHe cabinet. The 'sample_rotator' moving-part entry actually represents the linear sample-transport motor (stepper/optical encoder) in the rod head; the enum has no 'linear_transport' value. The 'sample_space.height' is the 4 cm field-uniform region, not a physical chamber length. Standard dewar capacities: 70 L LHe / 60 L LN2 (brochure) vs 65 L LHe (GmbH sheet). SQUID-VSM frequency is not stated in any located QD document; MPMS 3 appnote 1500-031 only says the sample oscillates at a chosen frequency. Cryogen enum: LHe bath with LN2 jacket (no mechanical cooler in the standard non-EverCool version).
